assets.negative_control_scope: Whole-hull filling is an advisory negative control for enclosed voids; unbounded outside approaches need not intersect it. Blocked floor controls and wrong-frame marker checks remain required.

method: Independent evaluated source triangles, exact native GLB node transforms, paired source-to-native direction conversion, named source-part contact and solid-join witnesses. Empty boxes additionally undergo triangle/box SAT, source solid containment and exact convex halfspace feasibility. Finite clear rays are sampled in all three axes of every declared preserved void, with independent blocked structural controls. Actual source and native visual intersections are compared with collision compounds; a whole-component hull supplies negative controls.
limits: Finite probes are not continuous coverage/error certification, engine physics, real host moving-door fit, service procedure, guard compliance or universal actor/cart fit.
Source markers classify fixed physical surfaces separately from optional receivers, openings and pose datums. Native clips/skins are counted; no absent motion is inferred.
